name: localnest-mcp

tools.name: localnest_server_status
tools.description: Return runtime status and active configuration summary for this MCP server.

tools.name: localnest_health
tools.description: Return a compact runtime health summary for fast smoke checks.

tools.name: localnest_usage_guide
tools.description: Return concise best-practice guidance for users and AI agents using this MCP.

tools.name: localnest_help
tools.description: Get task-scoped tool guidance. Describe what you want to do and receive a tailored list of tools, workflow steps, and tips.

tools.name: localnest_update_status
tools.description: Check npm for the latest localnest-mcp version on the selected channel (cached, default every 120 minutes).

tools.name: localnest_update_self
tools.description: Update localnest-mcp globally via npm and sync bundled skill. Supports stable, beta, or explicit version targets. Requires explicit user approval.

tools.name: localnest_task_context
tools.description: [QUICK_REHYDRATION] Bundle runtime status, memory state, and relevant recall for a non-trivial task in one call.

tools.name: localnest_memory_status
tools.description: Return local memory feature status, consent state, and backend compatibility.

tools.name: localnest_memory_recall
tools.description: Recall the most relevant local memories for a task or query. Use item_format=compact to drop content/metadata (~50% fewer tokens) or lite to return only id+title (~85% fewer tokens).

tools.name: localnest_capture_outcome
tools.description: [COMPLETE_MISSION] One-call mission summary capture. Use this after completing a task, fixing a bug, or making a major architectural decision to persist the "Winner" state for future agents.

tools.name: localnest_agent_prime
tools.description: [MANDATORY_START] The single most important tool for task initialization. Rehydrates project context, recalled memories, KG entities, relevant files, recent changes, and suggested actions in one call. Always call this BEFORE deeper research.

tools.name: localnest_whats_new
tools.description: Cross-session delta: new memories, KG triples, file changes, and commits since a given timestamp or last session.

tools.name: localnest_teach
tools.description: Teach the agent a durable behavior rule. Stores a high-importance feedback memory that auto-surfaces in agent_prime when future tasks match the instruction domain. Use this to set persistent preferences, coding standards, or workflow rules that should apply across sessions. Teach memories can be listed (kind=feedback), updated, or deleted via existing memory CRUD tools.

tools.name: localnest_memory_list
tools.description: List stored memories with optional scope, kind, nest, branch, and tag filters. Use item_format=compact to drop content/metadata (~50% fewer tokens) or lite to return only id+title (~85% fewer tokens).

tools.name: localnest_memory_get
tools.description: Fetch one stored memory with revision history.

tools.name: localnest_memory_store
tools.description: Store a durable local memory entry.

tools.name: localnest_memory_update
tools.description: Update a stored memory entry and append a revision.

tools.name: localnest_memory_delete
tools.description: Delete a stored memory entry and all of its revisions.

tools.name: localnest_memory_delete_batch
tools.description: Delete up to 100 memory entries in a single call. Returns the count of deleted entries and per-row errors for IDs that were not found or failed.

tools.name: localnest_memory_capture_event
tools.description: Ingest a background work event and auto-promote meaningful events into durable memory.

tools.name: localnest_memory_events
tools.description: List recently captured memory events and whether they were promoted into durable memory.

tools.name: localnest_memory_suggest_relations
tools.description: Find semantically similar memory entries that could be linked to a given memory. Uses dense embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) when available, falls back to token overlap. Returns candidates ranked by similarity without creating any relations — use localnest_memory_add_relation to confirm.

tools.name: localnest_memory_add_relation
tools.description: Link two memory entries with a named relation. Use to build a traversable knowledge graph (e.g. "depends_on", "contradicts", "supersedes", "related").

tools.name: localnest_memory_remove_relation
tools.description: Remove a relation between two memory entries.

tools.name: localnest_memory_related
tools.description: Return all memory entries linked to a given memory ID, traversing the knowledge graph one hop in both directions.

tools.name: localnest_memory_store_batch
tools.description: Store up to 100 memory entries in a single atomic transaction. Deduplicates via fingerprint and optional semantic similarity. Returns created/duplicate counts and per-row validation errors.

tools.name: localnest_list_roots
tools.description: List configured local roots available to this MCP server.

tools.name: localnest_list_projects
tools.description: List first-level project directories under a root.

tools.name: localnest_project_tree
tools.description: Return a compact tree of files/directories for a project path.

tools.name: localnest_read_file
tools.description: Read a bounded chunk of a file with line numbers.

tools.name: localnest_file_changed
tools.description: Report that a file was edited and receive proactive hints about high-importance memories linked to it. Memories with importance >= 70 that reference the file are flagged with suggest_update=true, indicating the memory may need updating to reflect the file change.

tools.name: localnest_summarize_project
tools.description: Return a high-level summary of a project directory.

tools.name: localnest_index_status
tools.description: Return local semantic index status and metadata.

tools.name: localnest_embed_status
tools.description: Return active embedding backend/model status and vector-search readiness.

tools.name: localnest_index_project
tools.description: Build or refresh semantic index for a project or across all roots.

tools.name: localnest_search_files
tools.description: [FAST_DISCOVERY] Search file paths and names matching a query. Use this first when looking for a module, feature, or component by name (e.g. "sso", "payment", "auth").

tools.name: localnest_search_code
tools.description: [EXACT_MATCH] Search text across files under a project/root and return matching lines. Best for exact symbol names, imports, or known identifiers.

tools.name: localnest_search_hybrid
tools.description: [DEEP_ANALYSIS] Run lexical + semantic retrieval and return RRF-ranked results. Best for queries where concepts and context matter as much as exact keywords.

tools.name: localnest_get_symbol
tools.description: [SYMBOL_INDEX] Look up symbol definitions/exports by name using fast regex search.

tools.name: localnest_find_usages
tools.description: [USAGE_ANALYSIS] Find call sites and import usages of a symbol by name.

tools.name: localnest_kg_add_entity
tools.description: Create or update an entity in the knowledge graph. Entity IDs are auto-generated as normalized slugs (lowercase, underscored).

tools.name: localnest_kg_add_triple
tools.description: Add a subject-predicate-object triple to the knowledge graph. Entities are auto-created on first reference. Detects contradictions (same subject+predicate with different valid object) and warns without blocking.

tools.name: localnest_kg_add_entities_batch
tools.description: Create up to 500 entities in a single transactional batch. Returns created/duplicate counts and per-row errors. Use response_format "verbose" to get back an ids[] array.

tools.name: localnest_kg_add_triples_batch
tools.description: Add up to 500 triples in a single transactional batch. Entities auto-created on first reference. Deduplicates against active triples.

tools.name: localnest_kg_query
tools.description: Query all relationships for an entity in the knowledge graph with optional direction filtering (outgoing, incoming, or both).

tools.name: localnest_kg_invalidate
tools.description: Set valid_to on a triple to mark it as no longer current. The triple remains in history but is excluded from current-state queries.

tools.name: localnest_kg_as_of
tools.description: Query triples for an entity at a specific point in time. mode="event" (default) returns facts whose valid_from/valid_to bracket the date (event-time axis). mode="transaction" returns every triple LocalNest knew at that time via recorded_at, regardless of valid_to (transaction-time axis).

tools.name: localnest_kg_timeline
tools.description: Get a chronological timeline of all triples for an entity, including invalidated facts. Ordered by valid_from date ascending.

tools.name: localnest_kg_stats
tools.description: Get knowledge graph statistics: total entity count, total triple count, active triple count, and breakdown by predicate type.

tools.name: localnest_kg_backfill_links
tools.description: Retroactively scan existing memories and create KG triples linking them to matching entities. Processes memories in batches. Use limit/offset for pagination.

tools.name: localnest_nest_list
tools.description: List all nests (top-level memory domains) with their memory entry counts.

tools.name: localnest_nest_branches
tools.description: List all branches (topics) within a specific nest with their memory entry counts.

tools.name: localnest_nest_tree
tools.description: Get the full taxonomy tree: all nests, their branches, and memory counts at each level.

tools.name: localnest_graph_traverse
tools.description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a starting entity with configurable max hops (default 2). Uses recursive CTEs with cycle prevention. Returns discovered entities with path information.

tools.name: localnest_graph_bridges
tools.description: Discover cross-nest bridges (default) or cross-branch bridges within a nest. Use mode="cross-branch" with a nest to find entities that span different branches within that nest.

tools.name: localnest_diary_write
tools.description: Write a private diary entry for an agent. Diary entries are isolated and only visible to the owning agent.

tools.name: localnest_diary_read
tools.description: Read recent diary entries for a specific agent. Only returns entries belonging to the requesting agent.

tools.name: localnest_ingest_markdown
tools.description: Ingest a Markdown conversation export into memory entries and knowledge graph triples. Pass the full text content directly — file reading is handled by the CLI, not MCP tools.

content.description: Full markdown text content to ingest

source_label.description: Optional label for re-ingestion tracking (e.g. filename)

tools.name: localnest_ingest_json
tools.description: Ingest a JSON conversation export (array of {role, content, timestamp?} objects) into memory entries and knowledge graph triples. Pass the full JSON text directly.

content.description: Full JSON text content to ingest

tools.name: localnest_memory_check_duplicate
tools.description: Check whether content is a semantic duplicate of an existing memory entry. Uses embedding cosine similarity with configurable threshold (default 0.92). Returns the matching entry when a duplicate is found.

tools.name: localnest_hooks_stats
tools.description: Returns hook system statistics: whether hooks are enabled, total registered listener count, and a breakdown of listener counts per event type.

tools.name: localnest_hooks_list_events
tools.description: Returns all valid hook event names that listeners can subscribe to. Covers memory lifecycle (store, update, delete, recall), knowledge graph operations (addEntity, addTriple, invalidate), graph traversal, diary, ingestion, dedup, taxonomy, and catch-all wildcards.

tools.name: localnest_kg_delete_entity
tools.description: Delete a knowledge graph entity by ID. Cascades: also deletes all triples where the entity is subject or object.

tools.name: localnest_kg_delete_entities_batch
tools.description: Delete up to 100 knowledge graph entities in one call. Cascades: also deletes all triples where each entity is subject or object. Returns count of deleted entities and removed triples.

tools.name: localnest_kg_delete_triples_batch
tools.description: Hard-delete up to 100 knowledge graph triples by ID. Unlike invalidate (which sets valid_to), this permanently removes the triples.

tools.name: localnest_project_backfill
tools.description: Scan a directory for projects and create seed memory entries for those with zero existing memories. Detects package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle, and .git. Use dry_run=true to preview without writing.

tools.name: localnest_find
tools.description: Search across memory entries, code chunks, and knowledge graph triples in a single call. Results are re-ranked across all sources using normalized scores. Each item includes a source field ("memory", "code", or "triple"). Use the sources parameter to limit which backends are queried.

tools.name: localnest_audit
tools.description: Run a comprehensive self-audit of LocalNest health. Returns memory coverage by project, KG density metrics (entities, triples, orphans, duplicates, connected components), unpopulated nests, broken bridges, stale memories, a 0-100 health score, and actionable suggestions. Call once to get a full integrity dashboard.

tools.name: localnest_find_callers
tools.description: Find every call site of a function or method across indexed files. Returns file path, line number, and surrounding context for each call. Requires the project to be indexed first via localnest_index_project.

symbol.description: The function or method name to find callers of

project_path.description: Scope search to a specific project

language.description: Filter by language: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust

tools.name: localnest_find_definition
tools.description: Jump to the declaration location(s) of a symbol across TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust files. Returns file path, line range, and declaration text. Requires the project to be indexed first via localnest_index_project.

symbol.description: The symbol name to find the definition of

project_path.description: Scope search to a specific project

language.description: Filter by language: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust

tools.name: localnest_find_implementations
tools.description: Find every class, struct, or object that implements a given interface or trait. Supports TypeScript implements, Python class inheritance, Rust impl-for, and Go struct patterns. Requires the project to be indexed first via localnest_index_project.

interface_name.description: The interface or trait name to find implementations of

project_path.description: Scope search to a specific project

language.description: Filter by language: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust

tools.name: localnest_rename_preview
tools.description: Preview every location that would change when renaming a symbol. Does NOT modify any files -- returns a dry-run list of changes grouped by file. Requires the project to be indexed first via localnest_index_project.

old_name.description: The current symbol name to rename

project_path.description: Scope search to a specific project

tools.name: localnest_backup
tools.description: Create a point-in-time backup of the LocalNest memory database using SQLite VACUUM INTO. The backup is a clean, compacted SQLite file verified with PRAGMA integrity_check. If destination is omitted, the backup is written to {memoryDbDir}/backups/{timestamp}.db.

destination.description: Absolute or relative path for the backup file. Defaults to {memoryDbDir}/backups/{timestamp}.db

tools.name: localnest_restore
tools.description: Restore the LocalNest memory database from a backup file. Verifies backup integrity before replacing the live database. IMPORTANT: The MCP server must be restarted after restore for changes to take effect.

source.description: Path to the backup .db file to restore from
